{{Dialogue|Luke Skywalker|So now what?|Lando Calrissian|We catch a ride into the Southern Underground. Keep that lightsaber out of sight but close to hand&mdash;this is not the kind of place you want to take your granny for tea, if you know what I mean.|Luke|Bad as Mos Eisley?|Lando|Parts of it are worse.|attr=[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]|src=<ref name="SotE" />}}
The '''Southern Underground''' was a section of the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant Underground]], located near [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] south pole. 

The Southern Underground had very ancient tunnels, which were some of the few places where the planet's original bedrock could be accessed, because of its very ancient tunnels.<ref name="sotes">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>
==Environment==
The dank atmosphere smelled of old machinery, rotting flesh and waste. As no natural light, or infrastructure, reached the underworld, the Underground had an eternal twilight, illuminated by the outcasts's firepits, as well as maintenance lights that often sputtered. [[Glow-fungus]] also contributed to the grim atmosphere.<ref name="sotes" />

Walls were covered by mold, fungi and graffiti, made by grease or [[blood/Legends|blood]], smeared by crazy doomsayers, homeless vandals or gangs marking their territory. In turn, the older graffiti were blurred by sludge and liquid which leaked from maintenance systems in the levels above, or condensation blowing into lower altitudes. Sludge gathered to the ground and formed pools.<ref name="sotes" />
===Ecosystem===
Prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Stone mite/Legends|stone mites]] first appeared here, but were held under control by [[Duracrete slug/Legends|duracrete slugs]] and [[Dianoga/Legends|dianogas]]. 

Walls were often covered by oxygen-producing yellow [[Fungus/Legends|fungus]], blue-gray [[Mold/Legends|mold]] as well as [[Glow-fungus]].<ref name="sotes" />
==Population==
Various outcasts and refugees ended up to the Coruscant underground, some of them fugitives from the Galactic Empire. Some joined gangs of thieves or became bandits; those hid in armored strongholds and hideouts full of traps, striking out from them and praying upon weaker individuals. Some of them however were agreeable anough to sell services.<ref name="sotes" />

The minority however were able to continue their lives along with them, continuing their trade and opening small businesses like shops.<ref name="sotes" />

The most unfortunate joined colonies of beggars, who carved makeshift hives out of vent-ways, maintenance pipes, machinery and other debris.<ref name="sotes" />

==Economy==
During the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],  it was home to a thriving [[Black market/Legends|black market]], which presented all manner of illicit offerings.<ref name="SotE" /> The "economy" of the Southern Underground seemed to rely on exchange of information and services for equipment, food, or even shelter, even without [[Currency/Legends|currency]].<ref name="sotes" />

[[Thief/Legends|Thieves]] and [[smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] "imported" goods from the upper levels, mostly from the nearby [[Hasamadhi warehouse district]], careful not to draw attention by stealing too much. This loot, resold in the black market or shops, boosted a bit the underground economy.<ref name="sotes" />

Some credits came from customers who came from Coruscant's fringe population, rarely even from the surface, who sought shadowy business.<ref name="sotes" />

{{Loc-stub}}
==Geography==
A huge hemispherical cavern, as large as a city block, served as the main plaza. Grungy establishments were built around the perimeter of that chamber, most of them shops and kiosks ran by undesirables who sought to make a living there: such as bakers, weapons outfitters, clothes and shoes sellers, electronics market, as well as a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] and a [[cantina/Legends|cantina]]; [[Spero]] made his [[Spero's plant shop|plant shop]] there.<ref name="sotes" />

It also contained [[Grid 17]] and [[Grid 19]].
